tasks_completed.description: Extended sessionScanner to read subagent JSONL files
tasks_completed.changes: Added readdir import. Refactored readSessionLog into readJsonlFile (shared parser) + readSubagentLogs (reads <sessionId>/subagents/*.jsonl) + readSessionLog (merges main + subagent messages sorted by timestamp).
tasks_completed.rationale: Subagent messages (isSidechain: true) were only available during live SDK streaming. On session resume, the scanner only read the main JSONL file, missing all subagent conversation history. Now it reads subagents/ directory and merges chronologically.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Fix B required extracting readJsonlFile from readSessionLog (to avoid duplicating file-parsing logic), adding readSubagentLogs (readdir + parse + collect), and modifying readSessionLog to merge + sort. This is the minimum viable implementation.
